title: Token-driven density ramps and microaction button system for virtual tables
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: Our table component supports multiple density presets but the implementation is a mix of hard-coded styles and ad-hoc component props. This makes it hard to maintain consistent spacing, token-driven theming, and predictable behavior across virtualized rendering. Additionally, inline microactions (icon buttons, kebabs) currently use inconsistent paddings and hit targets between desktop and touch contexts, causing accessibility and usability regressions in dense modes.

Goal: Define a token-first approach for table density (a "density ramp") that maps to spacing, typography, and row height tokens, and design a compact microaction button system to live inside table cells that remains accessible and performant when rendered in virtualized lists. Deliver tokens, design specs, visual assets, and a clear engineering handoff with edge cases called out.
acceptance_criteria: Design tokens defined: density.{compact,default,relaxed} mapped to rowHeight, cellPadding, iconSize, touchPadding
Table component consumes tokens and toggling density updates layout without layout shift artifacts during virtualization (no flash when switching density)
Microaction button spec: three sizes (icon-only compact, icon+label default, overflow kebab) with minimum 32px touch target regardless of visual size
Keyboard navigation and screen reader semantics preserved for dense rows: focus ring visible, announceable labels, skip links for inline actions
Visual regression snapshots added for each density across major breakpoints and with virtualized rows (100 / 1k / 10k row scenarios)
Engineering has a documented CSS tokens file and usage examples; integration PR references this ticket and passes visual/axe checks
tasks: Exploration: sketch 4 candidate density ramps and microaction layout variants (Maya) - due 2026-03-07
Token spec: produce token names, values, and rationale (Maya + Design Tokens doc)
Prototype: Figma prototype including live examples with overflow menu and keyboard flows (Julian)
Engineering sync: 1-hour workshop to align on token export format and virtualization perf considerations (Julian + ENG leads)
Handoff: Create a small design package with CSS vars / token table, interaction notes, and edge-case screenshots
QA: Add visual snapshot tests and keyboard/voiceover checks; measure render perf with virtualization harness
notes: 2026-03-02: Initial exploration session - three density concepts sketched; team prefers a 3-step ramp (compact/default/relaxed) to reduce combinatorial complexity.
2026-03-06: Accessibility review flagged touch target problems in compact mode. Decided minimum 32px touch target enforced via increased touchPadding token while visual padding can remain smaller.

2026-03-10: Eng sync: virtualization team (ENG-1987) warns that per-cell portals (for menus) are expensive. Recommendation: use a single portal per table and position menus from virtualized anchors when possible.
2026-03-12: Prototype updated with keyboard-first flows; added explicit announceable label pattern for icon-only microactions.
2026-03-15: Preparing handoff package and checklist for ENG-1987 PR. Updated acceptance criteria to require visual snapshots against virtualization harness.
qa_checklist: Verify density token values applied to table storybook stories
Confirm no layout jump when switching density at 1000-row virtualized example
Keyboard: navigate into table cell, activate microaction, and escape back to cell focus
Screen reader: icon-only microaction announces its purpose (aria-label or hidden text)
Visual: run Percy/Chromatic snapshots for compact/default/relaxed across 3 breakpoints
Performance: compare mean frame render time for table with 10k rows before/after tokens applied (target: <=5% regression)
